_about: Generated by mod/tools/extract-profile-keys.py. Do not edit.

avoidFoliage.comment: If this is true then parks will have no foliage (trees and flowers currently)

avoidWater.comment: If true then all water will be avoided (replaced with air)

baseBlock.comment: Block to use as the worldgen base

bedrockLayer.comment: The height of the bedrock layer that is generated at the bottom of some world types. Set to 0 to disable this and get default bedrock generation

bridgeChance.comment: The chance that a chunk can possibly contain a bridge. There actually being a bridge also depends on the presence of adjacent bridges and other conditions

bridgeSupports.comment: If true bridges get supports when needed. You can disable this if you have bridges that span void chunks

buildingChance.comment: The chance that a chunk in a city will have a building. Otherwise it will be a street

buildingDoorwayChance.comment: The chance that a doorway will be generated at a side of a building (on any level). Only when possible

buildingFrontChance.comment: The chance that a building will have a 'front' part if this is possible (i.e. adjacent street)

buildingMaxCellars.comment: The maximum number of cellars (below ground). 0 means no cellar

buildingMaxFloors.comment: A cap for the amount of floors a city can have (above ground)

buildingMaxFloorsChance.comment: The amount of floors of a building is equal to: MINFLOORS + random(MINFLOORS_CHANCE + (cityFactor + .1f) * (MAXFLOORS_CHANCE - MINFLOORS_CHANCE))

buildingMinCellars.comment: The minimum number of cellars (below ground). 0 means no cellar

buildingMinFloors.comment: The minimum number of floors (above ground) for a building (0 means the first floor only)

buildingMinFloorsChance.comment: The amount of floors of a building is equal to: MINFLOORS + random(MINFLOORS_CHANCE + (cityFactor + .1f) * (MAXFLOORS_CHANCE - MINFLOORS_CHANCE))

buildingWithoutLootChance.comment: The chance that a building will have no loot and no spawners

chestWithoutLootChance.comment: The chance that a chest will have no loot

cityAvoidVoid.comment: Only used with floating landscape type: if true an additional detection is done to see if the chunk is void and in that case the city isn't generated there. Otherwise you might get city chunks on the border of islands which sometimes looks weird

cityChance.comment: The chance this chunk will be the center of a city (use -1 for perlin noise variant)

cityLevel0Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 0

cityLevel1Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 1

cityLevel2Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 2

cityLevel3Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 3

cityLevel4Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 4

cityLevel5Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 5

cityLevel6Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 6

cityLevel7Height.comment: Below this chunk height cities will be level 7

cityMaxHeight.comment: Above this height cities will not be generated

cityMaxRadius.comment: The maximum radius of a city

cityMinHeight.comment: Below this height cities will not be generated

cityMinRadius.comment: The minimum radius of a city

cityPerlinInnerScale.comment: The internal scale for the city rarity perlin map

cityPerlinOffset.comment: The offset for the city rarity perlin map

cityPerlinScale.comment: The scale for the city rarity perlin map

citySpawnDistance1.comment: At this distance from spawn (in blocks) the city factor will be equal to CITY_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER1

citySpawnDistance2.comment: At this distance from spawn (in blocks) the city factor will be equal to CITY_SPAWN_MULTIPLIER2. If this is 0 then no scaling is done

citySphereChance.comment: The chance that a city sphere will be generated

citySphereClearAbove.comment: Number of blocks to clear above the top city sphere glass (0 is disabled)

citySphereClearAboveUntilAir.comment: If enabled this will additionally clear blocks above what is already cleared by CLEARBOVE until air is reached

citySphereClearBelow.comment: Number of blocks to clear below the top city sphere (0 is disabled)

citySphereClearBelowUntilAir.comment: If enabled this will additionally clear blocks below what is already cleared by CLEARBELOW until air is reached

citySphereFactor.comment: Only used in 'space' landscape. This factor will be multiplied with the radius of the city to calculate the radius of the outer sphere

cityStyleAlternative.comment: Alternative city style. Used with cityStyleThreshold

cityStyleThreshold.comment: A city factor below this threshold will use the city style specified in 'cityStyleAlternative'

cityThreshold.comment: The center and radius of a city define a sphere. This threshold indicates from which point a city is considered a city. This is important for calculating where cities are based on overlapping city circles (where the city thresholds are added)

corridorChance.comment: The chance that a chunk can possibly contain a corridor. There actually being a corridor also depends on the presence of adjacent corridors

debrisToNearbyChunkFactor.comment: A factor that determines how much debris will overflow from nearby damaged chunks. Bigger numbers mean less debris

editMode.comment: If true then this world is in edit mode

explosionChance.comment: The chance that a chunk will contain an explosion

explosionMaxHeight.comment: The maximum height of an explosion

explosionMaxRadius.comment: The maximum radius of an explosion

explosionMinHeight.comment: The minimum height of an explosion

explosionMinRadius.comment: The minimum radius of an explosion

explosionsInCitiesOnly.comment: If this is true the center of an explosion can only be in a city (the blast can still affect non-city chunks)

fogBlue.comment: This is used client-side (but only if the client has this mod) for the fog color

fogDensity.comment: This is used client-side (but only if the client has this mod) for the fog density

fogGreen.comment: This is used client-side (but only if the client has this mod) for the fog color

fogRed.comment: This is used client-side (but only if the client has this mod) for the fog color

forceSpawnBuildings.comment: A list of buildings that the player will spawn in if FORCE_SPAWN_IN_BUILDING is true. If this is empty then any building will do. This can be used in combination with 'forceSpawnParts'

forceSpawnInBuilding.comment: If this is true the player will spawn in a building. This can be used in combination with the other spawn settings

forceSpawnParts.comment: A list of parts that the player will spawn in if FORCE_SPAWN_IN_BUILDING is true. If this is empty then any part will do. This can be used in combination with 'forceSpawnBuildings'

fountainChance.comment: The chance that a street section contains a fountain

generateLighting.comment: If true then there will be minimal lighting in the buildings

generateLoot.comment: If true the chests in the buildings will contain loot

generateNether.comment: If true then generate a cavern type world in the Nether

generateSpawners.comment: If true then the buildings will be full of spawners

grid32.comment: If this is true then city spheres are aligned to a 32x32 grid. Otherwise they are aligned to a 16x16 grid

highwayDistanceMask.comment: Mask to control how far highways can generate. Must be a power of 2 (minus 1). If 0 there are no highways at all

highwayLevelFromCities.comment: 0 (take height from top-left city), 1 (take minimum height from both cities), 2 (take maximum height from both cities), 3 (take average height)

highwayMainPerlinScale.comment: For highways on a certain axis, this value is used to scale the perlin noise generator on the main axis. Increasing this value will increase the frequency of highways but make them smaller

highwayPerlinFactor.comment: The highway perlin noise is compared to this value. Setting this to 0 would give 50% chance of a highway being at a spot. Note that highways only generate on chunks a multiple of 8. Setting this very high will prevent highways from generating

highwayRequiresTwoCities.comment: If true then a highway will only generate if both sides have a valid city. If false then one city is sufficient

highwaySecondaryPerlinScale.comment: For highways on a certain axis, this value is used to scale the perlin noise generator on the secondary axis. Increasing this value will increase the variation of nearby highways

highwaySupports.comment: If true highways get supports when needed. You can disable this if you have highways that span void chunks

horizon.comment: This is used client-side (but only if the client has this mod) to set the height of the horizon

icon.comment: The icon to use in the configuration screen (64x64)

liquidBlock.comment: Block to use as a liquid

miniExplosionChance.comment: The chance that a chunk will contain a mini explosion

miniExplosionMaxHeight.comment: The maximum height of a mini explosion

miniExplosionMaxRadius.comment: The maximum radius of a mini explosion

miniExplosionMinHeight.comment: The minimum height of a mini explosion

miniExplosionMinRadius.comment: The minimum radius of a mini explosion

monorailChance.comment: The chance that a city will have a monorail connection in a certain direction. There will only be an actual connection if there is a city in that direction that also wants a monorail

multiUseCorner.comment: Determine whether the multibuilding should use surrounding average level, or just top left corner level.

oceanCorrectionBorder.comment: Terrain correction offset that is used for chunks adjacent to city chunks that are in ocean biomes

onlyPredefined.comment: If this is true then only predefined spheres are generated

outsideGroundLevel.comment: Ground level for outside city spheres (DEPRECATED, USE GROUNDLEVEL OF OTHER PROFILE)

outsideProfile.comment: An optional profile to use for the outside world

outsideSurfaceVariation.comment: Smaller numbers make the surface outside a city sphere more varied

parkBorder.comment: If true parks border will use the street block as base.

parkChance.comment: The chance that a non-building section can be a park section

parkElevation.comment: If true parks get an extra layer of elevation

parkStreetThreshold.comment: Determines how many surrounding street it needs to generate a park, based on current chunk's park chance.

railwayDungeonChance.comment: The chance that a chunk next to a railway will have a railway dungeon

railwayStationsEnabled.comment: If true then railway stations are enabled

railwaySurfaceStationsEnabled.comment: If true then railway surface station are enabled, otherwise there'll only be underground stations.

railwaysCanEnd.comment: If true the a place where a station would have been if there was a city above will have an 'ending' rail part if one side of the 'station' has no connections. Useful in case cities are rare

railwaysEnabled.comment: If true then railways are enabled. If false they are not (but stations will still generate)

randomLeafBlockChance.comment: Chance that leafblocks will be generated at the border of a building and a street

randomLeafBlockThickness.comment: Frequency of leafblocks as seen from the sides of buildings

rubbleDirtScale.comment: The scale of the dirt layer. Smaller values make the layer larger. Use 0 to disable

rubbleLayer.comment: If this is true an alternative way to generate dirt/stone/sand + leave blocks is used that makes the city appear more overgrown

rubbleLeaveScale.comment: The scale of the leave layer. Smaller values make the layer larger. Use 0 to disable

ruinChance.comment: This gives the chance that a building is ruined

ruinMaxlevelPercent.comment: If a building is ruined this indicates the maximum start height for the ruin destruction layer

ruinMinlevelPercent.comment: If a building is ruined this indicates the minimum start height for the ruin destruction layer

scatteredChanceMultiplier.comment: Multiplier for the chance a scattered building will generate. With 0 all scattered buildings are disabled

spawnBiome.comment: When this is set the player will always spawn in the given biome

spawnCheckAttempts.comment: The number of attempts to find a valid spawn location. If this is not enough then this will error

spawnCheckRadius.comment: The start radius to check for a valid spawn location. This value will be increased with 100 if it couldn't find a valid spot

spawnCity.comment: When this is set the player will always spawn in the given predefined city

spawnNotInBuilding.comment: If this is true the player will not spawn in a building. This can be used in combination with the other spawn settings

spawnRadiusIncrease.comment: The radius increase to use if the spawn check radius is not large enough to find a valid spawn location

spawnSphere.comment: When this is set the player will always spawn in the given predefined sphere. If you use <in> the player will always spawn in a random sphere. If you use <out> the player will always spawn outside a sphere

sphereSurfaceVariation.comment: Smaller numbers make the surface inside a city sphere more varied

terrainFixLowerMaxOffset.comment: To fix terrain adjacent to cities, this is the maximum offset (relative to city base level) for the lower mesh used to potentially raise the terrain

terrainFixLowerMinOffset.comment: To fix terrain adjacent to cities, this is the minimum offset (relative to city base level) for the lower mesh used to potentially raise the terrain

terrainFixUpperMaxOffset.comment: To fix terrain adjacent to cities, this is the maximum offset (relative to city base level) for the upper mesh used to potentially lower the terrain

terrainFixUpperMinOffset.comment: To fix terrain adjacent to cities, this is the minimum offset (relative to city base level) for the upper mesh used to potentially lower the terrain

useAvgHeightmap.comment: City normal level generation is now dependent on surrounding heightmap and get an average of the surrounding heightmap. This uses extra performance since it needs to retrieve surrounding city heightmaps.

vineChance.comment: The chance that a block on the outside of a building will be covered with a vine

worldStyle.comment: The worldstyle used by this profile (defined in the assets)
